claims: Pomona College is a private liberal arts college in Claremont, California.
Pomona College has a 7:1 student-faculty ratio.
Pomona College is a founding member of The Claremont Colleges consortium.
Pomona College is need-blind for domestic applicants.
Pomona College meets 100% of demonstrated financial need.
Pomona College has an acceptance rate of around 7%.
Pomona College is located about 35 miles from Los Angeles.
An 876-student class was admitted for 2030 at Pomona College.
Pomona College covers 100% of demonstrated financial need without student loans.
Pomona College features over 250 student-run organizations.
FOX 11 Los Angeles reported recent concerns regarding a string of racist incidents at Pomona College.
FOX 11 Los Angeles reported a call for better administration response at Pomona College.
Pomona College's mascot is Cecil the Sagehen.
